fee_notes: Formula is greater of $35,000 or $350/room; in 2025 actual Initial Fees ranged $25,000–$28,000. Application Fee of $2,500 credited toward Initial Fee. raw_excerpt: The Initial Fee for a new construction or conversion Chain Facility is equal to the greater of $35,000 or $350 per room. In 2025, our Initial Fees ranged from $25,000 to $28,000.
